notes: Distributed the 18 canonical grenades across all eight FEHA manufacturers instead of defaulting almost everything to ForgeLine Industries.

Assignments follow company identity: Kurohane smoke/cutting, Bastion tactical flash/incendiary sticky, Lumen homing/recon targeting, Vektor smart sticky/incendiary variants, Helix biohazard, ForgeLine heavy conventional explosive/incendiary ordnance, Jade Arc EMP, and Corvus persistent network recon.
Grenade catalog migration now writes canonical manufacturer/company metadata, creates missing company folders under 04 — GRENADES, and moves world grenade items into the correct manufacturer folder.
Grenade cards now always display the canonical manufacturer from the catalog rather than stale legacy item metadata.
Owned grenades keep their inventory location but receive corrected manufacturer metadata and canonical grenade schema.
